title: Sound-Reactive Fish Sculpture
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D sound-reactive sculpture scene using Three.js. Load the fish model 'BarramundiFish.glb' using GLTFLoader from a CDN.

## Scene Setup
- Black background (0x000000) with fog (near: 1, far: 50)
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at origin
- One DirectionalLight (white, intensity 1.5) at (5, 10, 5)
- One AmbientLight (0x331155, intensity 0.4)
- A ground plane (CircleGeometry radius 6, dark purple 0x1a0033, metalness 0.9, roughness 0.1)
- OrbitControls enabled but with autoRotate initially OFF

## Fish Model & Sculpture
- Load 'BarramundiFish.glb' and clone it 8 times to create a circular sculpture arrangement
- Place the 8 fish clones evenly spaced in a circle of radius 3, each rotated to face outward
- Each fish should have a unique index (0-7) and start at a base Y position of 1.0
- The fish sculpture should pulse/animate based on a simulated audio frequency system

## Simulated Audio System
- Since we can't use real audio, simulate 8 frequency bands using sine waves with different frequencies
- Each band i uses: amplitude = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * (1.0 + i * 0.3) + i * Math.PI/4)
- Store current frequency values in an array of length 8
- Each fish index i responds to frequency band i

## Dynamic Difficulty System
- Implement 5 difficulty levels (1-5), starting at level 1
- Each level changes the sculpture behavior:
  - Level 1: Fish only bob up/down by frequency * 0.5
  - Level 2: Fish bob + scale (1.0 + frequency * 0.3) uniformly
  - Level 3: Fish bob + scale + rotate around Y axis (frequency * Math.PI)
  - Level 4: All above + fish change emissive color intensity (frequency * 0x3366ff)
  - Level 5: All above + particle trails spawn behind each fish
- Display current difficulty level in a HUD element

## Particle System
- Create a particle system with max 500 particles (small spheres or points)
- Particles are only active at difficulty level 5
- Each particle has position, velocity (slight upward drift + random), lifetime (2 seconds), and opacity
- Active particle count should be tracked

## User Interactions
- Press '1'-'5' keys to set difficulty level directly
- Press 'Space' to toggle pause/resume of the audio simulation (animation continues but frequencies freeze)
- Press 'R' to reset all fish to base positions and set difficulty to 1
- Press 'A' to toggle autoRotate on OrbitControls
- Click on any fish (raycasting) to highlight it - highlighted fish pulses 2x amplitude
- Press 'P' to toggle a performance mode that reduces fish count to 4 (every other fish hidden)

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: 'Difficulty: X' label (id='hud-difficulty')
- Top-right: 'Particles: N' label (id='hud-particles')
- Bottom-left: 'FPS: XX' label (id='hud-fps')
- Bottom-center: 'Status: PLAYING/PAUSED' label (id='hud-status')
- Style all HUD elements with white text, semi-transparent dark background, padding 8px, font-family monospace

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- difficultyLevel: number (1-5)
- isPaused: boolean
- autoRotate: boolean
- fishCount: number (visible fish, 4 or 8)
- selectedFishIndex: number (-1 if none selected)
- frequencyBands: array of 8 numbers (current simulated amplitudes, 0.0-1.0)
- averageFrequency: number (mean of all 8 bands)
- fishPositions: array of 8 objects {x, y, z} (current world positions)
- activeParticles: number
- performanceMode: boolean
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since start, frozen when paused)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true after GLB loads)
- fishScales: array of 8 numbers (current uniform scale of each fish)
- totalResets: number (how many times R was pressed)
physics_constraints: Fish Y positions must stay within [0.5, 3.5]. Frequency bands must be in [0.0, 1.0]. Particle lifetimes decay linearly. Fish scales must be in [0.7, 2.0]. Particle count must not exceed 500. All numerical values must be NaN-free.
